text: Grandfather here, looking after my granddaughter overnight, she's 3 months old. I'd like a clear answer please rather than being told to ring somewhere else. Her temperature was 38.6 at 9pm. Her parents left Calpol and the instructions from the pharmacist so she's had the right dose for her age. Between doses she's absolutely fine in herself, smiling at me, cooing away, feeding as normal and taking the full bottle. Nappies are wet, I've changed three since tea time, so she's not drying out. She's also got a few insect bites on her arm from the garden this afternoon which she seems to find itchy, rubbing at them, little red bumps, nothing more than that. That's the whole picture. What I want to know is simple: do I need to take her in tonight or is this something I can keep an eye on at home until her parents are back in the morning. I'll do whatever you say but I want it in plain terms.
